checks: Current KG receives existing full fixture validation before SourceGraph and proposed-world validation.

ValidateDiscoveryWorld still checks independent review descriptors, candidate binding, schema/bounds, all KG concept snapshots and authored provenance against the current source graph before bootstrap.

content.Load produces a fresh digest-verified embedded Content; only Nodes, Edges, Labels, CategoryLabels, NormalizedIndex and validated normalized DiscoveryWorld are overlaid in the private audit instance, matching the existing quick-audit pattern.
All recipe/goal/restore/historical-prefix replay loops remain unchanged; serving loader, contentbuild.Load, installer and authority gates are unmodified.

The public Audit wrapper still snapshots and rechecks runtime/source inventories and binds exact catalog/candidate bytes; ConfirmFinal and the installed-authority readset/stability checks remain unchanged.

Focused test proves a current proposed world can be audited while installed-world snapshots are stale; stale proposed snapshots are refused, installed-world bytes stay exact and full source-export loading still refuses the incoherent staged root.
limitations: The durable pre-install audit is replay/source-binding evidence for separate final factual and quality judgments; this implementation review does not grant content approval.
After installation and export/pin updates, regenerate the populated authority ledger audit/final bindings and perform the required assembled integration recheck.

resolved_finding.problem: Replacing the full root export loader with the sealed baseline initially removed global KG fixture validation; SourceGraph is a parser and does not certify graph metadata, counts, aliases, endpoints or puzzle contracts.
resolved_finding.resolution: auditWorld now calls the existing full contentbuild.ValidateFixture against current KG before parsing/validating/replaying the proposal. The malformed-count negative proves a parser-valid and snapshot-valid world cannot bypass that separate gate.

scope: Supplemental code review of offline prospective-world audit bootstrap only; no lexical, relation, recipe or concept quality approval.
